purpose: Follow-up to the 63-effect Python 3.15 sampling sweep: gradient lookup, Soap smear, triangle waveform.

method.input: deterministic synthetic PCM through real aubio/melbank DSP; local fixtures

changes: Gather contiguous RGB gradient triples with np.take and retain the channel-first API.
Specialize triangle wave arithmetic while preserving phase scaling, float64 promotion, operation order and uncommon-dtype fallback.

Use line slices and clamped palette edges for Soap smear with two reusable line buffers. Preserve indexed path below 128 samples per line or 16384 total pixels; microbenchmarks showed per-line overhead regressed small matrices.
limitations: Single-host synthetic performance, not physical LED latency or every preset/configuration.
Before and after runs are sequential, not randomized; min/max and raw results expose variation.
UDP frame drops are measured separately; rendered frames and websocket messages do not imply complete DDP delivery.
Profile shares exclude import/shutdown stacks but include warmup. Five-second profiles screen hotspots; improvement claims use separate unprofiled repeats.
Synthetic input replaces hardware capture and frontend/browser overhead; server CPU excludes receiver and sampler.
Python 3.15 remains experimental; project Python support metadata is unchanged.
reproduce: Repeat after changes with --baseline /tmp/before.jsonl and a new --output.

next_targets.direction: Investigate native noise generation batching/vectorization or optional lower-resolution generation, with explicit image-quality and configuration tradeoffs for the latter.

next_targets.direction: Measure contiguous RGB gather in the separate HSV gradient path and caching invariant initial wave/ramp data; preserve rounding and configuration invalidation.
